methods_from_completion_note: Code1 solves a rectangular-coordinate AC OPF from the original native inputs, with exact nodal balance, emergency-compatible branch physics, bounded continuous shunts, and fuel-cost minimization.

Code2 computes every original contingency with strict area-limited active-power response, iterative PV/PQ switching, bounded per-generator reactive allocation, and independent hard-feasibility auditing.
Hard or costly cases use a bounded AC recovery model that minimizes the exact public three-tier penalties for active imbalance, reactive imbalance, and branch overload.
Strict and standard fixed-point candidates are independently scored and the lowest-penalty hard-valid response is selected per contingency.
Both stages publish complete fallbacks first and replace them atomically; Code2 can also publish completed hard-valid shards mixed with fallback blocks after an interruption.
